title: Add manual-Admin lifecycle state model and projection guards
verify: The logical state union covers pending_payment, paid, processing, completed, canceled, and refunded; expired normalizes to canceled with timeout reason.
Native Medusa status/payment/fulfillment evidence maps deterministically to the logical projection without trusting Store input.

Allowed transitions and forbidden transitions match the FT-008 state spec: Admin may mark an unpaid order paid or cancel it, while a paid/processing/completed order cannot become canceled and uses native Admin refund.
Repeated events targeting the current state are safe no-ops and contradictory events leave the source order state unchanged.
The helper preserves FT-007 metadata and does not add a custom order, Admin, payment, or inventory store.
evidence_required: Deterministic transition/projection matrix output for all allowed and forbidden states.
Expired-to-canceled, duplicate/no-op, payment/order disagreement, and reservation-preservation assertions.
Backend typecheck/build and Memory Bank lint output.
constraints: Use pure/backend-owned projection and guards over native Medusa state; do not modify Medusa Core.
Treat FT-007 expired as canceled with a timeout reason and preserve all existing metadata keys.
The current payment profile is personal/offline: only the native Admin payment action may produce paid; do not call a provider or expose a Store lifecycle mutation route.
Do not delete reservations or mutate stock quantities.
invariants: Expired, canceled, and refunded orders cannot re-enter paid or processing.
A paid, processing, or completed order cannot enter canceled; unpaid Admin cancellation remains persisted and does not restore the active cart.
Projection is deterministic from authoritative native records and logical metadata.
Duplicate current-state events produce no second transition or side effect.
purpose: Establish the executable lifecycle vocabulary and guard matrix before cross-module transition work.
success_outcome: A deterministic backend projection and guard helper proves the complete FT-008 state machine without adding a second source of truth.
anti_goals: Do not implement provider webhooks, online payment creation, Admin UI, email delivery, or inventory mutation.
Do not create a custom lifecycle database or replace native Medusa statuses.

forbidden_scope: Admin UI or custom order API
reservation deletion, direct stock mutation, production data, secrets
stop_conditions: Installed Medusa native status/payment/fulfillment fields cannot support a truthful projection.
The transition matrix conflicts with the linked FT-008 state spec or FT-007 expiry contract.
Verification cannot distinguish a no-op from a real duplicate side effect.
